payload.title: Decide how the papyrus CLI signs in without Prospectus
payload.description: Agents and editors use the signed-in `papyrus` CLI. On the existing sites remote login goes through Prospectus, which Humorus does not use at launch. Decide and document the sign-in path for this deployment (the newsroom's own Google sign-in, or IAM through the single sign-on profile for operators), and file the Papyrus issue if neither works.
